title: Godzilla
description: Godzilla, King of the Monsters, arises to combat massive, malevolent foes that have been feeding on a nuclear plant's reactors and now threaten mankind with total annihilation.

title: Blade Runner 2049
description: After discovering a long-buried secret that jeopardizes what's left of society, a new Blade Runner embarks on a quest to find Rick Deckard, a former Blade Runner who's been missing for 30 years.

title: Pulp Fiction
description: Two hit men (John Travolta, Samuel L. Jackson), a boxer, a crime boss and others meet their fates over the course of two days.

title: Wes Craven Presents: Dracula 2000
description: A London antiques dealer (Christopher Plummer) travels to New Orleans to save his estranged daughter from his nemesis, Count Dracula (Gerard Butler).

title: Personal Shopper
description: A young American in Paris works as a personal shopper for a celebrity. She seems to have the ability to communicate with spirits, like her recently deceased twin brother. Soon, she starts to receive ambiguous messages from an unknown source.

title: True Grit
description: A teenage girl (Hailee Steinfeld) enlists the aid of a boozy, trigger-happy lawman (Jeff Bridges) to hunt down her father's killer (Josh Brolin).

title: The Bodyguard
description: An ex-secret service agent falls for his client, an actress and singer someone wants dead before the Academy Awards.

title: My Cousin Vinny
description: Two New Yorkers accused of murder in rural Alabama while on their way back to college call in the help of one of their cousins, a loudmouth lawyer with no trial experience.

title: Million Dollar Baby
description: A deep bond develops between a cantankerous trainer (Clint Eastwood) and the female boxer (Hilary Swank) he reluctantly takes under his wing.

title: Gladiator
description: A former Roman General sets out to exact vengeance against the corrupt emperor who murdered his family and sent him into slavery.

title: Top Gun
description: For Lieutenant Pete "Maverick" Mitchell and his friend and co-pilot Nick "Goose" Bradshaw, being accepted into an elite training school for fighter pilots is a dream come true. But a tragedy will threaten Pete's dreams of becoming an ace pilot.

title: Top Gun: Maverick
description: Pete "Maverick" Mitchell keeps pushing the envelope after years of service as one of the Navy's top aviators. He must soon confront the past while training a new squad of graduates for a dangerous mission that demands the ultimate sacrifice.

title: Indiana Jones and the Kingdom of the Crystal Skull
description: Indy (Harrison Ford) and a young adventurer (Shia La Beouf) must ferret out a powerful artifact and keep it out of the hands of a deadly Soviet agent (Cate Blanchett).

title: The Score

title: Whitney
description: Filmmaker Kevin Macdonald examines the life and career of singer Whitney Houston. Features never-before-seen archival footage, exclusive recordings, rare performances and interviews with the people who knew her best.

title: He's Just Not That Into You
description: Friends and lovers try to navigate their way through the complexities of modern relationships, sometimes misconstruing the true intentions of the opposite sex.

title: Colin from Accounts
description:
S03 E01 — Receptive Penile
Gordon and Ashley are determined to move on from the embarrassment of Gordon's ill-fated proposal at Megan and Rumi's pop-up wedding; but a chance encounter at a suburban GP clinic throws their plans for forward momentum off course.

title: Colin from Accounts
description:
S03 E02 — Clean, Honest, Open, Transparent Love
Ash reunites with Colin, and Gordon invites her, along with her eager boyfriend, David, to his birthday party at Echo Park Brewery, which is being thrown by his new girlfriend, Chelsea.

title: Colin from Accounts
description:
S03 E03 — Monstera
Ash and Gordon attempt to put their past behind them at dinner in a romantic but not too romantic restaurant, while David and Chelsea are both laser-focused on the future.

title: Colin from Accounts
description:
S03 E04 — New Beginnings Champagne Breakfast
After a revealing tapas dinner, Gordon and Ash take stock of their personal lives and romantic relationships; Brett attempts to renegotiate his place in Gordon's life.

title: Colin from Accounts
description:
S03 E05 — Druggy Druggy Sex Party
Ash meets Gordon to drop Colin off, and they're unsure where they stand; Ash joins a sexy game night at the share house just as Gordon shows up to check on Colin.

title: Colin from Accounts
description:
S03 E06 — Matching Set
Ash is hopeful that romance will rekindle when Gordon invites her on a weekend road trip, until she discovers that Brett and Chiara are joining them; when Chiara suggests they do a '90s thing and lock away their phones, things go downhill.

title: Colin from Accounts
description:
S03 E07 — Is That All There Is?
Ash attends her Nan's funeral, where she reunites with her long-absent father; Gordon and Heavy help their mom move into an aged care home.

title: Colin from Accounts
description:
S03 E08 — Rum 'n' Raisin
Ash grapples with Gordon's behavior at Brett's party; Lynette and Lee face trouble with the law; Colin's misadventure with a bag of raisins brings Ash and Gordon back together where their relationship first began.

title: Just Go With It
description: A plastic surgeon (Adam Sandler) enlists the aid of his assistant (Jennifer Aniston) and her children to help him win the heart of a beautiful woman.

title: Masterminds
description: An armored-car driver (Zach Galifianakis) helps a flirty co-worker (Kristen Wiig) and her friends pull off a heist, then finds himself holding the bag after they double-cross him.

title: Se7en
description: A meticulous detective and the young officer about to replace the veteran probe serial murders based on the seven deadly sins.

title: Sweetness
description: When a fan learns that her rock-star idol is spiraling into addiction, she makes it her mission to save him, whether he wants her help or not. However, when her desperate plan spins out of control, she kidnaps him in a delusional attempt to fix him.

title: Kiss the Girls
description: After escaping from a serial killer, a doctor (Ashley Judd) helps police and a forensic psychologist (Morgan Freeman) track the madman.

title: Along Came a Spider
description: A detective (Morgan Freeman) and a Secret Service agent (Monica Potter) investigate the abduction of a senator's daughter from a school.

title: Blindness
description: A doctor's wife is one of the few individuals immune to a strange epidemic that causes people to lose their eyesight.

title: The Haunting
description: A parapsychologist and three others stay in a house reputed to be the site of many awful tragedies and paranormal events.

title: A.I.: Artificial Intelligence
description: In the future a cutting-edge android in the form of a boy (Haley Joel Osment) embarks on a journey to discover his true nature.

title: Patriot Games
description: An IRA terrorist vows revenge against the ex-CIA agent who killed the man's brother and thwarted an attack on royalty.

title: Dunkirk
description: Germany advances into France, trapping Allied troops on the beaches of Dunkirk. Under air and ground cover from British and French forces, troops are slowly and methodically evacuated from the beach using every vessel that can be found.

title: Argo
description: During the Iran hostage crisis, an extraction specialist (Ben Affleck) in the CIA poses as a Hollywood film producer to rescue six Americans who eluded Iranian militants and found refuge with the Canadian ambassador.

title: The Aviator
description: During the 1930s and '40s, wealthy industrialist Howard Hughes (Leonardo DiCaprio) gains fame as a movie producer, airplane designer and pilot.

title: Homestead
description: A former green beret and other survivors take refuge inside an elaborate compound when an attack on America leaves the world in chaos.

description: A globe-trotter (Angelina Jolie) must find Pandora's box before a maniacal scientist (Ciarán Hinds) can harness its power for world domination.

description: A commodities trader (Michael Douglas) takes action when his wife (Gwyneth Paltrow) has an affair with a bohemian painter (Viggo Mortensen).

title: The Dutchman
description: Haunted by his crumbling marriage and an identity crisis, a successful but troubled businessman gets drawn into a psychological game of cat and mouse with a sinister, mysterious woman whom he encounters on a New York subway.
